titel: Check-ins for a lead working as a chat
kurz: A lead working as a chat is not woken by the AMW – they only see news when they look again. So that the project does not wait, the lead sets a reminder for themselves: a new one at the end of every check-in.
brauchst: A lead with the working mode “Chat” (Settings › Agents).
In their chat app, a way to be woken at a given time (a one-off scheduled task or reminder).
The project's interval: Settings › Project › “Lead pulse (minutes)”, default 120.

schritte.text: Enter the interval under Settings › Project. It says how often the lead looks at the latest.
In their chat app, the lead creates a one-off reminder – for now plus the interval, with a short neutral text (such as “check the AMW”). What to do is in the AMW, not in the reminder.

schritte.titel: At the end of every check-in
schritte.text: Look, work through it – and as the last thing create a **new** one-off reminder for the next check-in.
Leave expired reminders or delete them.

fehler: An existing reminder was changed (time, text, name, on/off or “recurring”). Every change to an existing reminder requires a click by the human; until then nothing happens. Remedy: delete it and create a new one.
That is a change too. Always use one-off reminders, a new one each time.
The lead does not react in between
That is intended: between two check-ins the human nudges them when something is urgent.
danach: The rule for this is part of the base rule set (optional, preselected for chat leads) and of the lead's mandatory context.
Agents working in the terminal do not need this – the AMW wakes them.
fragen: What was verified: creating and deleting work without a prompt, any change to an existing reminder does not. A one-off reminder, created anew each time, needs no click by the human.
What if the lead forgets the new reminder?
Then the check-ins end. The human nudges them; that is why the rule appears verbatim in the lead's mandatory context.
